preconditions.description: The length of the string s is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The length of the string t is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.
The string s contains at most one wildcard character '*'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz*' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists of lowercase Latin letters and at most one wildcard character '*'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: The string t consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if (s == t) or (s == '*' and m > 0) or (s.count('*') == 1 and s.replace('*', t) == t) or (s.split('*')[0] + s.split('*')[1] == t and m >= len(s.split('*')[0]) + len(s.split('*')[1])) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if the string t can be obtained from the string s by replacing the wildcard character '*' with an appropriate sequence of lowercase Latin letters, otherwise the output is 'NO'.
